fusions.name: Warren Thump
fusions.desc: Kicks for 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds. For 3 seconds after using it, you move 10% faster.

fusions.name: Bolt and Bite
fusions.desc: Bolts up to 7 tiles onto the target with a weapon strike that deals 14 damage and makes it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Startled Leap
fusions.desc: A short burst of movement that carries you 5 tiles forward.

fusions.name: Springloaded
fusions.desc: When you gain stamina, your critical hit chance rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
